title: Post office package delivery form
titleCn: 邮局寄包裹到美国填单

paragraphs.text: Part one.
You will hear a conversation between an assistant in a post office and a customer who needs to send a package overseas.
First, you have some time to look at questions one to eight.
Now listen carefully and answer questions one to eight.
Hello, can I help you?
Yes, I'd like to send this package to the USA urgently, but I'm not sure what the best way of sending it is.
Well, first of all, when does it need to get there?
Well, it's Tuesday today. It's absolutely got to be there by Friday. Ideally, I'd like it to be there by Thursday, but I realize that might be difficult.
Okay. Well, there's Courier Post, but that takes four working days, so that would be next Monday.
Mm-hmm.
Or a slightly more expensive service called International Express, which will get there in three working days.
Okay, I'll use that then. Um, it's really got to be there as quickly as possible.
Okay. Can I just take some details from you for the form?
Mm-hmm.
First of all, what's your name?
Peter White.
And your address?
14 Mountain Road.
And where's that?
That's in Lakeview.
Okay. Now, who are you sending the package to?
Um, Anna Hillman. That's H-I-double L-M-A-N.
And what's the address?
Apartment 228, North Building.
Okay.
Upper Park Avenue.
And what city is that in?
New York.
Now, I need a description of the contents of the package, just so customs know what's being sent.
I'm sending books.
How many are you sending? I need to give the number.
There are six in total.
Right. And is there anything else in the package?
Yes, some, some photographs.
Okay.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions nine and ten.
Now listen and answer questions nine and ten.
Now, would you like to insure the contents?
Hmm, it might be a good idea.
All right. Now, can we just weigh the package, and I'll tell you how much it's going to cost.
Ugh, here you are. It's heavy.
It's just over 4 kilos. So let's see. That's going to be 98 dollars altogether.
Will I be able to get a receipt with that?

Yes, of course. Now, if the package gets lost, you should contact us as soon as possible. It's very unusual for anything to go missing, but just in case, your receipt has an ID code on it, which we will need to be able to trace the package.
Right. So will I also need to bring in the receipt and the delivery form to you if it does get lost?
No, you can just give us a call with the ID code. Okay?
Mm.
Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all, and thanks for your help.
That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
